notes.title: Downware – Available April 25 !
notes.content:
Get ready for an unforgettable experience! Downware, our brand-new first-person Cyberpunk horror game, plunges you into a dark and oppressive world.

Where is Lucy? Your girlfriend has mysteriously vanished, and the truth lies hidden behind intricate puzzles, heart-pounding chase sequences, and a building laden with deadly traps. Under the relentless watch of Mark-13, a cyborg enforcer of martial law, every decision is crucial to escape a grim fate.

Experience immersive gameplay, authentic settings, and a chilling atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Mark your calendars for April, and prepare to explore a realm where mystery meets horror, and every corner hides a secret.

Get ready… Horror awaits!

notes.title: Update 1.3 - A new chapter begins
notes.content:
The deployment of update 1.3 marks the end of the bug resolution period. Our team will now be able to focus on adding content.


[h2]Update 1.3[/h2]
This early access period is a success, with your feedback we have improved the interface and corrected all the bugs.


[h2]A new chapter begins[/h2]
The bug correction phase having been completed, we will be able to attack the phase of adding new functionality. Send us your ideas.

The next updates will add achievements which, in addition to their basic functioning, will allow you to unlock new elements such as rare improvements to your city having a decisive impact on your adventure.

For the month of May, the following roadmap has been established:
[list]
[*] Added steam achievements
[*] Change to make combat more dynamic (adding a dash...)
[*] More lively city with the addition of new NPCs (guard...)
[*] Improved enemy AI
[*] Complete change to 3D models and trap mechanics
[/list]



[h2]Your feedback counts[/h2]
Aridide Production is a small development studio, which is why we look forward to your feedback.

The goal over the next few days/months is to fix reported bugs and work with the community to add content and new features.

notes.title: The adventure begin ! Demo release
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the demo of our game is now available on Steam!

We are excited to offer you a taste of the universe we have created. This demo represents a small portion of what you can expect in the full game, but we hope it will give you an exciting glimpse of what's to come.

We invite you to download the demo now and dive into this captivating adventure. Your feedback and comments will be invaluable to us, so please feel free to share your impressions on the game's page or contact us directly.

Thank you so much for your ongoing support. It's thanks to you that this project is coming to life, and we can't wait to share the final version with you in the near future!

Discord : https://discord.com/invite/YE5T9hv6UQ

Enjoy !
